column1: # Codes of errors.tsv that no program run on interrexx raises, one row per code.
# code<TAB>class<TAB>reason. A code with a probe program is not listed.

# message-only, utility, platform, no-site. A `no-site` row asserts that the
# interpreter sources have no raise site for the code; a test keeps that true.
